name: B Capital — Monthly PitchBook Portfolio Sync
notes: Flow Builder cron is 6-field (robfig): '0 0 6 1 * *' == 5-field '0 6 1 * *' (1st of month 06:00 UTC).
Webhook delivery target is the current API sandbox; re-point delivery[0].config.webhook.url when the API is redeployed (ephemeral sandbox).

First run honesty: the LLM pull node returned populated PitchBook fields for 1/136 companies (lambda, 13 fields); 135 records came back all-null with availability=not_available. The store keeps previously seeded profile data (1887 populated / 833 empty states across 20 fields x 136), so no field was blanked or invented.
